claims.evidence: Location (Abulegba) is not shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Exact model/capacity is unknown, which affects price and parts availability.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating plate/model number sticker (usually on the back or side) showing model and capacity (kg).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst-case for an unknown/older top-loader (lower capacity/older model) until model & capacity are confirmed.

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (may have weak spin, drainage issues, or non-functional controls).
risks.proof: A short video of a full wash cycle starting from power-on to draining/spinning (or at least spin) with water running.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / needs service until a working cycle is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: rust, worn drum bearings, leaking hoses, or damaged lid/hinges.
risks.proof: Photos of the back (hoses + power inlet), bottom edge, and any visible rust/leaks; plus a close-up of the lid seal/gasket.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having possible wear/maintenance needs until condition is shown.

risks.risk: Accessories/parts may be missing (inlet hose, drain hose, power cable, manual).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included items laid out (inlet hose, drain hose, power cable, any accessories).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing/uncertain accessories until confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating plate/model number sticker (back/side) including capacity (kg).
Video of a complete wash cycle showing draining and spinning.
Photos of back panel and hoses (inlet/drain) and any visible rust/leaks.
Photo of included accessories (inlet hose, drain hose, power cable).
response.reason: From the photo, it’s a NEXUS top-loading washing machine, but the model/capacity and working condition are not verifiable remotely. To price safely, we need the rating plate and proof it runs through a cycle.
